prompt:
Write a portfolio case study in Markdown for the freelancer Tobias Reyne (Full-stack developer - React, Next.js, Node.js and Postgres).

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Live fleet dashboard
client: Ferrylane Freight
client_industry: logistics
start: 2020-09
end: 2020-12
engagement: hourly
stack:
- React
- Socket.IO
- Node.js
- Redis
- Mapbox
implied_skills:
- pub/sub messaging
built: A dispatcher map showing every truck's position and ETA, pushed to the browser
  as GPS pings arrive.
metrics:
- 1,800 trucks tracked live
- under 2 seconds from ping to screen

Requirements:
- 300 to 450 words, first person, a short title line starting with "# ".
- Loosely cover the client's problem, what was built, and the results. Emphasis: business impact.
- Include one short code or config snippet (5 to 15 lines) in a fenced block that fits the stack.
- Refer to the client as "Ferrylane Freight".
- Never use these words or phrases: "pub/sub messaging". Describe the work so a reader can infer them.
